analysis.summary: Defines SiteDocument entity for associating documents with sites. Used in .NET HSPnet.DataLayer.
analysis.purpose: To represent documents attached to specific sites, holding SiteID and document ID.
system_behavior: Simple data container for a site document

analysis.summary: Implements .NET Web UI for staff admin welcome screen, including date filtering, validation, and status/error display panels.
analysis.purpose: To allow staff administrators to view filtered employment applications, see login info, and handle errors/warnings.

workflows.name: Employment Application Filter Workflow
steps: Start/end dates default to 3 months ago/today
Refresh or filter triggers RefreshData (DataBind on grid)
Grid row binds links for applicant name, email, shows status/withdrawal
Validation: Start date & end date required, end after start, correct format

business_rules: Hide or show withdrawn applications using checkbox
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for start and end dates
CustomValidator to check end date after start date
conditions: If SiteID query string param set, prefill site filter
Grid hides or shows rows/columns based on withdrawn status
system_behavior: Panels to show errors and warnings
Localization supported for labels and messages

analysis.summary: Defines ServiceCode entity and provides data access/business logic methods for listing and localizing service codes.
analysis.purpose: To retrieve, manage, and localize service code entities used throughout the application.

workflows.name: ServiceCode List Workflow
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll to list codes (using session credentials)
For each code, localize if alternate language is used

workflows.name: ASM Option By Course or Timetable
steps: Get codes for the given course or timetable

business_rules: Localize if UseAltLanguageFields is set on session
conditions: If UseAltLanguageFields, override Name with NameAlt
system_behavior: Accesses DB procedures for list and ASM option methods

analysis.summary: Tracks historical changes to Site profiles, including what fields were changed, who made the change, when, and in what section.
analysis.purpose: To provide a searchable history of all modifications to a Site's profile for audit and traceability.

workflows.name: SiteProfileHistory Search
steps: User triggers search with SiteID and SessionAgencyID
Stored procedure executed to fetch all history entries
Entries are presented with formatted user and agency details

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is set, use alternate language for field labels and actions
Show Support Team as user if sys admin is involved or user is not the original
system_behavior: Provides grid UI for history display

analysis.summary: Manages temporary email documents for popup selection/sending, including file deletion and search.
analysis.purpose: To hold details for email attachments presented in popups and allow deletion of selected files.

workflows.name: Popup List and Delete Workflow
steps: Call Search to generate attachment list from delimited string
Call Delete to remove a file and its folder if needed, based on index

business_rules: If DataInfo is empty, return empty list
Only delete file/folder if file path present
system_behavior: Handles file system deletes with try/catch
exceptions: Catches and ignores errors in file/folder delete operations
